text:
cleo: Heads-up — talk with CloudPartner on Monday about a private offer that bundles marketplace committed spend + hardware credits + SI onboarding credits. Need a proposal sketch before the call.

sanjay: OK. high-level ask from CP was 36M commit over 12 months, want blended discount + hardware incentive. wondering how to structure renewal guardrails. :thinking_face:

maria: For the marketplace SKU, we should separate the reserved-capacity SKU from the marketplace usage SKU. e.g. `redwood.dedicated.annual.1yr` vs `redwood.hosted.usage`. Keeps billing clean.

ben: +1 on SKU split. For hardware credits, propose a time-limited voucher that applies to Dedicated onboarding only (not usable on hosted). prevents gaming.

cleo: Good. CP also wants SI credits that the partner can use to offset SI fees for integrations (30% of onboarding cost). How do we codify that in the private offer?

elaine: We can add a non-billable line-item in the private offer: "SI-integration-credit" with zero unit price but attached to contract as an entitlement. Marketplace checkout will accept it only when partner submits integration claim via our partner portal. Keeps the credits off invoiced amount but legally committed.

maria: Renewal mechanics — we should include a consumption kicker: if partner consumes >90% of committed spend by month 10, auto-trigger a renewal discussion and uplift pricing floor for next period. Document as an optional appendice, not auto-charge.

cleo: Need language for discount stacking: committed discount applies only to marketplace usage and reserved SKU; hardware credits reduce partner invoice after committed discount is applied. Can we get legal to sign off on that?

ben: I'll draft the clause. Suggest phrasing: "Committed discount applies to eligible Redwood marketplace usage and reserved capacity SKUs. Hardware-credit vouchers are applied post-discount and are non-transferable."

partners-bot: Reminder: internal checklist for private offers — approvals required: Partnerships Lead, Finance, Legal, Product. Please attach projected ARR and variance table. :white_check_mark:

cleo: On the projected ARR — finance needs to see blended unit economics: baseline hosted gross margin, dedicated margin (post hardware credit), and SI credit impact on partner economics. Sanjay can you pull a 12mo P&L scenario?

sanjay: Yep. I'll run three scenarios: conservative (70% utilization), expected (85%), aggressive (95%). Will include token-level cost assumptions + hardware amortization.

maria: Also think about a carveout for strategic customers: allow full transferability of SI credits for top-tier SI partners only, with audit rights. That could be an optional add-on.

cleo: Nice. For the call, I want two slides: (1) offer summary + SKUs + credit mechanics, (2) renewal & escalation paths + approval flow. Can someone prepare before noon tomorrow?

ben: I'll put draft slide deck in Partnerships drive and ping y'all.

elaine: I'll draft the proposed private-offer wording and the entitlement flow for the partner portal (how they claim SI credits).

partners-bot: Note: scheduled meeting with CloudPartner set for 2024-11-18 16:00 PST. Checklist due 2024-11-17 09:00 PST.

cleo: Thanks team — quick sync 10:00 tomorrow to review deck. :thumbsup:

ben: ack.

maria: ack.

sanjay: ack.

elaine: ack.
